name: Resolution Data 5
definition: Specifies additional information as expected by the party that the investigation performs the expected actions for its resolution.

EndToEndIdentification.name: End To End Identification
EndToEndIdentification.definition: Unique identification, as assigned by the original initiating party, to unambiguously identify the original transaction.

TransactionIdentification.name: Transaction Identification
TransactionIdentification.definition: Unique identification, as assigned by the original first instructing agent, to unambiguously identify the transaction.

UETR.name: UETR
UETR.definition: Universally unique identifier to provide an end-to-end reference of a payment transaction.

InterbankSettlementAmount.name: Interbank Settlement Amount
InterbankSettlementAmount.definition: Amount of money moved between the instructing agent and the instructed agent.

InterbankSettlementDate.name: Interbank Settlement Date
InterbankSettlementDate.definition: Date on which the amount of money ceases to be available to the agent that owes it and when the amount of money becomes available to the agent to which it is due.

ClearingChannel.name: Clearing Channel
ClearingChannel.definition: Specifies the clearing channel to be used to process the payment instruction.

Compensation.name: Compensation
Compensation.definition: Provides the details of the compensation made due to the modification or cancellation of a previous payment.

ChargesInformation.name: Charges Information
ChargesInformation.definition: Provides information on the charges to be paid by the charge bearer(s) related to the payment transaction.
